    Fischbacher's reduction: killing arrows without changing the fundamental group #

    For arrows αᵢ : b → dᵢ of a finite ray category P, the quotient P' = P/⟨αᵢ⟩ annihilates every morphism factoring through some αᵢ (RayCat.arrowIdeal). Fischbacher (Zur Kombinatorik der Algebren mit endlich vielen Idealen, Crelle 370, 1986, Lemmas 2.1 and 2.2) chooses the αᵢ so that P and P' have the same fundamental group; iterating this proves that the fundamental group of a chain-finite ray category is free.
